import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22
2024-01-01,06:00,Latte,Large,6.37,2,Credit Card,45-54,1,12.74
2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Data Preparation
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
df['customer_age_group'] = pd.Categorical(df['customer_age_group'], categories=age_order, ordered=True)
df_sales_by_product = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().reset_index()
df_sales_by_age = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Visualization
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis (Sample Data)', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# Plot 1: Total Sales by Product
sns.barplot(ax=axes[0, 0], data=df_sales_by_product.sort_values('total', ascending=False), x='product', y='total')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
for p in axes[0, 0].patches:
    axes[0, 0].annotate(f'${p.get_height():.2f}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                        textcoords='offset points')

# Plot 2: Sales Trend Over the Day
sns.lineplot(ax=axes[0, 1], data=df.sort_values('datetime'), x='time', y='total', marker='o', color=sns.color_palette("viridis")[1])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Trend Over the Day', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Time of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Transaction Total ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)


# Plot 3: Total Sales by Customer Age Group
sns.barplot(ax=axes[1, 0], data=df_sales_by_age, x='customer_age_group', y='total', palette="viridis_r")
axes[1, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
for p in axes[1, 0].patches:
    if p.get_height() > 0: # Only annotate bars with value
        axes[1, 0].annotate(f'${p.get_height():.2f}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                            textcoords='offset points')

# Plot 4: Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[1, 1].pie(payment_counts, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140,
               colors=[sns.color_palette("viridis")[3], sns.color_palette("viridis")[5]],
               wedgeprops=dict(width=0.4))
axes[1, 1].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('') # Hide the y-label for pie chart

# Final adjustments and saving
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
